title: 桜花賞の後に・芽生え

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: So, I ran the first race of the Triple Tiara. I'm guessing you've seen the results on TV by now. I think I did a fine job, but…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Harp Alpha ran like the wind, and when she runs, you just can't take your eyes off her. I saw her and I knew I was watching a city girl.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I wanna dazzle everyone with my running like that! Here's hoping I can do that at my next race, the Japanese Oaks!
